overview.title: Overview
overview.staleHint: Profiles must be confirmed at least every 180 days; otherwise they are marked as outdated and ranked lower.
overview.staleNone: All ward profiles are up to date.
overview.blockers: {count, plural, one {# detail missing} other {# details missing}}
overview.pending: Your organisation is being reviewed. We are checking the UID against the UID register; until approval you can prepare wards and drafts, but not publish anything.
overview.agencyReview: Your organisation appears in the SECO directory of placement and staff-leasing agencies. A person is checking manually whether you are the employer yourself. Publishing is not possible until approval (AK-C1).
overview.rejected: Your organisation was not approved. Please contact support@kardia.ch with your UID.
overview.empty: No wards yet. Create the first ward – it holds the working conditions.
overview.error: This page is not available for your role or could not be loaded right now. If needed, ask the Owner of your organisation for more permissions.

onboarding.title: Register organisation
onboarding.lead: Only organisations that are themselves the employer for the advertised jobs may post on Kardia.
onboarding.name: Organisation name
onboarding.uidHint: Swiss business identification number, e.g. CHE-123.456.789
onboarding.domainsHint: One or more domains used by your staff, separated by commas, e.g. hospital-example.ch. Staff use them to verify themselves for the reality check.
onboarding.agencyBody: We check your UID against the public UID register and the SECO directory of licensed placement and staff-leasing agencies. Matches in the SECO directory are reviewed manually; until then, publishing is not possible.
onboarding.invited: Have you been invited? Open the invitation link in the email – no registration is needed then.
onboarding.already: You are already a member of an organisation.

form.invalid: This value is outside the permitted range. Please check.

location.name: Site name
location.geocodeFailed: Address not found. Check the street, postcode and town or enter the coordinates manually.
location.invalid: Details incomplete: a 4-digit postcode and coordinates within Switzerland are required. «Coordinates from address» fills them in.

wards.title: Wards
wards.emptyLocations: No site yet. First create a workplace with an address.
wards.emptyWards: There is no ward at this site yet.
wards.wardQuota: Your plan includes one ward. For more wards, choose the «Institution» or «Hospital group» plan.
wards.locationQuota: Your plan includes one site. For several sites, choose the «Hospital group» plan.

ward.newLead: The ward holds the working conditions. Every job inherits them and can override individual fields.
ward.needLocation: Please choose or create a site first.
ward.rosterHint: Clicking a day cycles Early → Late → Night → Day 12 h → off. Applies to 100 %; scaled for part-time.
ward.gavHint: Name of the collective agreement (GAV) or «no GAV».
ward.reentryHint: Required details: onboarding in weeks, accompanied shifts and refresher courses.
ward.descriptionHint: A supplement to the fields, never a replacement. Translated automatically into the other languages and remains editable.
ward.staleHint: This profile has not been confirmed for more than 180 days and is ranked lower in search. Check and confirm the details.
ward.noBenchmark: Shown only once there are 8 comparable wards in the same specialty and canton.
ward.importedAddress: Address from the job ad: {address}. No matching site yet – create it as a new site.

reality.hint: Verified staff confirm or dispute your details. Values appear from 5 responses. You can comment, but not delete or hide anything.
reality.tooFew: Fewer than 5 responses – not visible yet.
reality.commentHint: Up to 600 characters, shown publicly next to the team value. Saving it empty removes the comment.
reality.inviteHint: Invited staff are labelled «invited by employer». Staff with an email address on your domain can also verify themselves.

translations.hint: The description is translated automatically (AI translation). Check it and adjust if needed.

videos.hint: Up to {max} seconds, MP4 or MOV, with a subtitle file (WebVTT). Published after moderation.
videos.needBoth: Please choose a video and a subtitle file – no video without subtitles.
videos.tooLong: The video is longer than {max} seconds. Please shorten it.

import.unconfirmed: {count, plural, one {# imported value has} other {# imported values have}} not been checked yet
import.title: New job
import.lead: Paste an existing job ad: AI pre-fills the ward profile and you check every field. Or enter everything manually.
import.textHint: Up to 20,000 characters. You may remove the names of contact persons.
import.urlHint: Only pages on your own website – Kardia does not import ads from other portals.
import.aiNote: AI only takes values that appear verbatim or unambiguously in the text, with the source passage. It does not write any text.
import.waitingHint: This usually takes less than 30 seconds.
import.failed: The fields could not be detected automatically. Try again or choose «Enter manually».
import.reviewTitle: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} taken from the text
import.reviewHint: Every imported value is marked and shows the source passage. Please check and confirm every value.
import.missing: {count, plural, one {# required detail is} other {# required details are}} missing from the ad. Please add them directly below.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Import an existing job ad – in about 10 minutes.

job.workloadOrder: The maximum workload is below the minimum. Swap the values.
job.overridesHint: Leave empty = ward value. Only fill in if this job has different conditions.
job.pendingRecogHint: Professionals with an SRK or MEBEKO recognition in progress can be hired until it is completed (search filter «recognition in progress»).
job.trainingHint: Details according to the SIWF register of training centres. Deviations are reported in the admin dashboard.
job.rotationsHint: Separated by commas, e.g. emergency, intensive care
job.noTraining: Without a specialist title and category, the job is labelled «no recognised postgraduate training».
job.created: Check the preview and publish the job as soon as all required details are in place.
job.paid: Payment received. The single listing is active for 60 days.
job.previewHint: This is how professionals see the job: ward profile with this job's overrides.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.noJobs: No published job yet. Create a job to receive applications.
pipeline.noApplications: No applications for this job yet. In the marketplace you can approach suitable professionals directly.
pipeline.keyboard: Keyboard: J/K to move between applications, 1–6 sets the status (1 New … 6 Rejected), Enter opens.
pipeline.notAllowed: Moving from «{from}» to «{to}» is not possible.
pipeline.rejectHint: The professional receives the status immediately and also sees the reason from the fixed list.
pipeline.statusSaved: Status saved. The professional will be notified.

application.docsShared: Original documents shared for this application
application.docsNotShared: Documents not shared – only the review status is visible.
application.threadHint: Directly with the professional. Messages are stored encrypted.
application.noAutoDecision: Kardia makes no automated decisions. Passport match is a sorting aid, not an assessment.

marketplace.title: Marketplace search
marketplace.lead: Professionals set their conditions anonymously. You see no name, no photo and no employer – only when they express «interest» does the person share their name and contact details.
marketplace.needJob: Offers must refer to a published job with a ward profile. Publish a job first.
marketplace.notInPlan: The marketplace is included from the «Institution» plan (20 offers per month).
marketplace.empty: No matching profiles. Loosen the filters or search again later.
marketplace.offerHint: A concrete annual salary at 100 %, not a band. Valid for {days} days; at most one open offer per person.
marketplace.salaryHint: At least {min} (minimum of the ward's salary band).
marketplace.myOffersHint: Identity only after «interest» – the person then appears in the pipeline.
marketplace.declineTooFew: Reasons are only shown from 3 declines and only in aggregate.
marketplace.withdrawn: Offer withdrawn. The person will be notified.

pool.title: Flex pool
pool.lead: Single shifts and short assignments for your own relief pool – bookable directly instead of through temp agencies.
pool.legal: Pool members are employed by you (framework contract on an hourly wage). Kardia is purely software, stores no employment contracts and does not act as an employer.
pool.notInPlan: The flex pool is included from the «Institution» plan.
pool.noPools: No pool yet. Create the first one above.
pool.interests: {count, plural, one {# interested – assign} other {# interested – assign}}
pool.noShifts: No shifts in this pool yet.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.lead: Your wards compared with the median for the same specialties in your region. Values only appear from {min} comparable wards, so that no individual institution can be identified.
benchmark.notInPlan: The benchmark is included in the Institution and Hospital group plans.
benchmark.tooFew: Not enough comparable wards yet. Values appear from {min} wards in the same specialty in your region.
benchmark.noWards: Add a ward to compare it with others.

team.title: Team and settings
team.noPermission: Only the Owner role can invite members and change roles.
team.domainsHint: Separated by commas, e.g. hospital-example.ch. People with these domains can join via an invitation without further checks.
team.ssoAvailable: Company sign-in (OIDC) is included in your plan. The owner sets it up here.
team.ssoNotInPlan: Single sign-on is included in the Hospital group plan.
team.apiHint: For the REST API v1. The key is shown only once; store it in a safe place straight away.
team.apiNotInPlan: API and webhooks are included in the Hospital group plan.
team.keyOnce: Your new key – it is shown only now:
team.secretOnce: Webhook signing secret – it is shown only now:
team.webhookHint: HTTPS only. Every delivery is signed with the secret (Kardia-Signature header).
team.feedCreated: Feed added. The first fetch will happen within an hour.
team.feedHint: Imported jobs are saved as drafts; you publish them yourself after review.
team.ssoNeedsDomain: For company sign-in, first enter your organisation's e-mail domain above.
team.ssoLead: Staff with your e-mail domain sign in through your identity provider (OpenID Connect, e.g. Microsoft Entra ID). New people get the Viewer role; change the role afterwards under Members.
team.logoScanning: The logo is being checked and will appear shortly.
team.logoRejected: The logo was rejected during the check. Please choose another file.
team.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, max. 2 MB. Publicly visible once your organisation is verified.

billing.title: Plan and invoices
billing.noPlan: You do not have a plan yet. You can still publish single listings.
billing.paid: Payment received. Your plan will be active in a few seconds.
billing.foundingActive: You are a founding partner: {months} months of the Institution plan free of charge.
billing.foundingInfo: The first {slots} institutions in the canton of Zurich receive {months} months of the Institution plan free of charge. {free} places still available – write to partner@kardia.ch.
billing.noPermission: Only the Owner role can change the plan. Ask that person to complete the subscription.
billing.singleInfo: Without a plan: {price} per job for {days} days, including AI import and pipeline. Pay by card or TWINT directly on the job.
billing.invoicePlanInvalid: There is no invoice for this plan. Choose Institution or Hospital group on the plans page.
billing.terms: Payable within 30 days using the QR payment slip. The plan is activated once payment is received.
billing.portalHint: Change payment method, switch or cancel your plan – in the secure Stripe customer portal.
billing.stripeMissing: Card payment is not set up in this environment. Institution and Hospital group plans are available by invoice with QR payment slip.
billing.expired: The «{plan}» plan expired on {date}. Your jobs are no longer visible in search until you renew.

sso.signInHint: For organisations with single sign-on set up.
sso.signInFailed: No company login is set up for this e-mail domain. Please sign in with a passkey or e-mail link.
